correctness.rationale: Coordinate stationarity gives the stated first moments and \(\mathbb E[x^2\mid z]=bz\). Direct differentiation of \(\Phi=z+bx-(b/a)y\) gives \(L\Phi=x^2+(b/a)x\), which is exactly the shifted-circle identity after integration. Variation of constants makes \(z\ge0\) on every bounded complete trajectory and forces the origin when \(z=0\). The variance endpoints force the two equilibria. Finally the circle integrand is strictly below its mean level inside \(-b/a<x<0\) and strictly above outside the closed slab; if either region had zero mass, invariant-support continuity collapses the support to the equilibrium values. The inspected exact verifier independently checks the polynomial coboundary and equilibrium factorization.

final_claim: For the generalized Sprott F flow, every compactly supported invariant probability obeys the exact conditional height law and the shifted stationary circle; the two circle endpoints are precisely the two equilibrium measures, while every other compact recurrent state has positive mass both inside the natural equilibrium slab and outside its closed boundary, with the corresponding periodic-orbit excursion consequence.
limitations: The theorem gives necessary constraints and excursion behavior; it does not prove existence, uniqueness or ergodicity of nontrivial compact invariant sets for a given parameter pair.
